journey.name: Triage — edit a card before publishing
journey.description: The Review-cards triage step (spec §5.5, design U92Nh): paste a list, edit one card's front/back text in triage, keep the rest, publish, and confirm the edit persisted in the deck. Requires a signed-in session (run journey 01 first).

actions.action: Launch the Loopky app and verify the Home screen is shown
Tap the element with resource-id "tab_decks" in the bottom tab bar
Type the following two lines into the field with resource-id "paste_input": "hola,hello", "gracias,thanks"
Verify the "Review cards" triage screen is shown with the first card front "hola" (resource-id: triage_front)
Tap the element with resource-id "triage_edit" to edit the first card
Verify the edit screen is shown with editable front (resource-id: triage_edit_front) and back (resource-id: triage_edit_back) fields
Clear the field with resource-id "triage_edit_front" and type "buenos dias"
Clear the field with resource-id "triage_edit_back" and type "good morning"
Verify the triage screen is shown again and the first card front now reads "buenos dias" (resource-id: triage_front)
Tap the element with resource-id "triage_keep" to keep the first card
Tap the element with resource-id "triage_keep" to keep the second card and advance to Publish
Enter "Greetings ES" into the field with resource-id "publish_title"
Verify the deck detail screen for "Greetings ES" shows a card with front "buenos dias" and back "good morning"
